answer_1.quote: Radiology report generation ... has attracted increasing research attention. In this paper, we propose ORGAN, an Observation-guided radiology Report GenerAtioN framework.
answer_1.outputs: Free-text radiology reports describing chest X‑ray images

answer_2.quote: We adopt natural language generation metrics (NLG Metrics) and clinical efficacy (CE Metrics) to evaluate the models. BLEU, METEOR, and ROUGE are selected as NLG Metrics, and we use CheXpert for CE Metrics.
